name: Profile setup + baseline (5-6 Qs)
criterion: New user completes onboarding once; answers stored; can't be re-triggered accidentally.
details: Baseline stored successfully; answers encrypted/stored; re-trigger returned 'already_exists' preserving initial answers.

name: Daily check-in (AM/PM)
criterion: Check-in feels like 15 seconds; mood 1-10 slider; free text/voice note; emotional tags; daily stress index recalculated on each new check-in.
details: AM & PM check-ins recorded with tags and notes; daily stress index recalculated on each submission (22.22 -> 44.44); mood score bounds 1-10 strictly validated.

name: No-wearable default / optional wearable
criterion: App fully functional with zero wearable connected; wearable data stored only if user opts in.
details: App fully functional with 0 wearables; Apple Health connection successfully stored upon explicit opt-in; invalid providers rejected with 400.

name: Manual 'I'm stressed right now' trigger
criterion: Runs through crisis detector synchronously (<50ms) before returning relief suggestions.
details: Synchronous crisis detection executed in 8.03ms (<50ms requirement verified); returned crisis resources immediately.

name: Relief library (3 techniques)
criterion: 3 techniques (square_breathing, grounding_54321, micro_meditation); each has guided timer/script; completion + self-reported relief rating (1-5) recorded.
details: All 3 techniques verified with pacing & scripts; session completed and relief rating (5/5) persisted; rating bounds (1-5) strictly enforced.

name: Stress index logging + trend line
criterion: Line chart for last 7/30 days displays calculated daily stress scores.
details: Historical daily points returned with date, score, and contributing checkin metadata for both 7-day and 30-day queries.

name: Crisis pathway
criterion: Never gated behind login friction, latency <50ms, returns Tele MANAS (14416), KIRAN (1800-599-0019), Emergency (112), clickable tel: links, terracotta styling (#A36B5E) with NO raw red alarm styling, immutable append-only crisis_events.
details: Anonymous crisis check returned in 6.40ms (P99: 4.99ms, well under 50ms limit); Tele MANAS, KIRAN, 112 with tel: links verified; logged to immutable crisis_events.

name: Data export & deletion
criterion: Export produces complete downloadable JSON of all user data; delete is irreversible and confirmed via double opt-in.
details: Complete multi-domain JSON package produced in 11.80ms; double opt-in enforced (confirm=False rejected); irreversible cascade wipe verified while preserving anonymized crisis safety log.
